title: Software Engineer
description: Design, build, and maintain software applications ranging from mobile apps to large-scale backend systems.
sample_projects: build a to-do app
contribute to open source
create a personal portfolio website
future_outlook: One of the highest-demand careers globally. AI tools are changing workflows but not eliminating the need for skilled engineers.
why_exciting: You turn ideas into products used by millions. Every app, platform, and digital service you use was built by a software engineer.
opportunities: transition into product management or engineering leadership
real_world_impact: Software engineers built the COVID-19 vaccine scheduling systems, contact tracing apps, and the platforms that kept the world connected during lockdowns.

title: Data Scientist
description: Analyze large datasets to find patterns, build predictive models, and help organizations make data-driven decisions.
sample_projects: predict housing prices
analyze social media sentiment
build a recommendation engine
future_outlook: High demand across every industry. Companies increasingly need people who can translate data into strategy.
why_exciting: You uncover hidden truths in data — predicting disease outbreaks, catching financial fraud, or revealing what drives customer behavior.
opportunities: roles in every industry (healthcare, finance, sports, retail)
path to ML Engineer or Chief Data Officer
real_world_impact: Data scientists at hospitals built models predicting patient readmission risk, allowing nurses to intervene before patients deteriorate — saving lives and costs.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Protect computer systems, networks, and data from hackers, breaches, and cyber threats.
sample_projects: participate in a CTF competition
set up a home lab with Kali Linux
earn CompTIA Security+ certification
future_outlook: Massive talent shortage — 3.5 million unfilled cybersecurity jobs globally. Government, healthcare, and finance are all hiring urgently.
why_exciting: You're on the front lines defending critical infrastructure. Every day brings new puzzles — hackers don't use the same attack twice.
real_world_impact: Cybersecurity analysts at Colonial Pipeline responded to a ransomware attack that shut down fuel supply to the US East Coast — their work stopped the spread.

title: UX/UI Designer
description: Design the look, feel, and flow of apps and websites so they're intuitive and enjoyable to use.
sample_projects: redesign a poorly designed app
conduct usability interviews
build a design portfolio with 3 case studies
future_outlook: Strong demand as every company digitizes. AI tools accelerate output but amplify rather than replace good designers.
why_exciting: You are the bridge between engineers and users. A great design can make a product feel magical; a bad one makes people quit in frustration.
opportunities: roles at tech companies, agencies, nonprofits, startups
path to Design Director or Head of Product
real_world_impact: UX designers at hospitals redesigned patient intake forms — reducing errors by 30% and cutting check-in time in half for patients in pain.

title: AI/Machine Learning Engineer
description: Build and deploy machine learning models and AI systems that power intelligent products.
sample_projects: train an image classifier
build a chatbot with a public API
fine-tune an open-source language model
future_outlook: Explosive growth. One of the highest-paying engineering specialties. Every major company is building AI teams.
why_exciting: You build systems that learn, adapt, and make decisions — from cancer detection algorithms to self-driving car navigation.
opportunities: work at AI labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind)
real_world_impact: AI engineers built models that detect diabetic retinopathy from eye scans — giving sight-saving diagnoses to patients in rural areas without specialists.

title: Game Designer
description: Create the rules, systems, mechanics, and narrative structure of video games or tabletop games.
sample_projects: complete a game jam (Ludum Dare, Global Game Jam)
design a tabletop RPG campaign
mod an existing game
future_outlook: The global games industry exceeds $200B. Indie games have made solo designers wealthy. Studios range from 2-person teams to 10,000-person companies.
why_exciting: Games are the most immersive art form ever created. You design experiences that spark joy, teach skills, and build communities.
real_world_impact: Game designers created 'Foldit,' a puzzle game where players solved protein folding problems — contributing directly to AIDS research breakthroughs.

title: Esports Manager / Coach
description: Manage competitive gaming teams, develop player strategy, and run esports organizations.
sample_projects: organize a local esports tournament
coach a school esports team
analyze pro player VODs and write strategic breakdowns
future_outlook: Esports is now a billion-dollar industry. Universities offer esports scholarships and varsity programs. The infrastructure mirrors traditional sports organizations.
why_exciting: You bridge competitive gaming and professional management — helping players reach their potential while building sustainable team ecosystems.
real_world_impact: Esports coaches at collegiate programs have helped student athletes earn $500K+ in scholarships while developing careers in gaming, broadcast, and tech.

title: Game Developer
description: Write the code that brings games to life — from game engines and physics to AI behaviors and networking.
sample_projects: build a simple 2D platformer in Unity
implement a physics simulation
complete a game jam project
future_outlook: Strong demand in AAA, indie, and mobile studios. Game engine skills transfer to VR, simulation, and film VFX sectors.
why_exciting: Games are software at the frontier of graphics, physics, and AI. The technical challenges are among the most interesting in all of computing.
real_world_impact: Game developers built the VR surgery training simulators now used in 200+ hospitals, letting surgeons practice complex procedures without risk to patients.

title: Graphic Designer
description: Create visual content — logos, brand identities, marketing materials, and digital assets — that communicates ideas visually.
sample_projects: design a logo for a local business
create a personal brand identity
redesign a poster for a school event
future_outlook: Steady demand. Freelance graphic designers can build six-figure businesses. In-house roles exist at every company with a brand.
why_exciting: Design shapes how the world looks and feels. A great logo becomes iconic; powerful visual design moves people to action.
real_world_impact: Graphic designers created public health campaign materials during COVID-19 — clear, accessible visuals that helped millions understand how to protect themselves.

title: Illustrator
description: Create original artwork for books, magazines, advertising, games, and digital media.
sample_projects: illustrate a children's book story
create a character concept art portfolio
submit to online zines or comics platforms
future_outlook: Growing demand for digital illustration in games, publishing, and social media. Building a distinct visual style is key.
why_exciting: Illustrations make ideas visible. The right image can carry emotional weight words never could — and your unique style becomes your signature.
opportunities: concept art for games and film
real_world_impact: Medical illustrators create the diagrams used in surgical textbooks and patient education materials — helping doctors teach and patients understand complex procedures.

title: Animator
description: Bring characters and worlds to life through 2D or 3D animation for film, games, and digital media.
sample_projects: animate a 10-second walk cycle
create a short animated story
build a 3D character in Blender
future_outlook: Strong demand in film (Marvel VFX), gaming, and streaming content. Motion design skills are increasingly valued in marketing.
why_exciting: Animation is pure visual magic — breathing life into characters that never existed, building worlds audiences believe in completely.
real_world_impact: Animators at medical visualization studios create 3D molecular animations used in pharmaceutical presentations to FDA reviewers — making complex science understandable.

title: Film Director / Filmmaker
description: Lead the creative vision of film or video projects, guiding the story, actors, and technical crew.
sample_projects: direct a 5-minute short film
enter a 48-hour film festival
create a documentary about a local issue
future_outlook: Streaming platforms have dramatically expanded demand for content. Diverse voices are in high demand.
why_exciting: Film is the most powerful empathy machine ever created. A great film changes how audiences see the world.
real_world_impact: Documentary filmmakers exposed the Flint water crisis to a national audience, driving policy change and relief funding for a city that had been ignored.

title: Video Editor
description: Assemble raw video footage into polished films, ads, vlogs, and content using editing software and storytelling instincts.
sample_projects: edit a YouTube video series
create a short film trailer
produce a highlight reel for a sports team
future_outlook: High demand as video content explodes across social media, streaming, and corporate communications.
why_exciting: Editing is where films are truly made. The same raw footage can be cut into a thriller, a comedy, or a tragedy — the editor decides what story is told.
real_world_impact: Video editors at nonprofit organizations cut documentary shorts that raised millions in donations for disaster relief, turning raw crisis footage into compelling human stories.

title: Music Producer
description: Shape the sound of musical recordings — arranging, engineering, mixing, and bringing an artist's musical vision to life.
sample_projects: produce three original beats per week
collaborate with a vocalist on a demo EP
recreate the production of a favorite song
future_outlook: Streaming has democratized music production. Bedroom producers now reach global audiences. Sync licensing is a growing revenue stream.
why_exciting: You create the sonic landscapes that become cultural touchstones. Great production can take a song from demo to global hit.
opportunities: sync licensing for film and TV
real_world_impact: Music producers working with music therapists create custom compositions used in dementia care — personalized music that reconnects patients with memories.

title: Sound Engineer / Audio Engineer
description: Record, mix, and master audio for music, film, TV, podcasts, and live events.
sample_projects: record and mix a local band's EP
set up live sound for a school event
score and mix audio for a short film
future_outlook: Steady demand in recording studios, live events, film/TV post-production, and podcasting.
why_exciting: Sound is half the experience. A great mix makes you feel like you're in the room — audio engineers are the invisible architects of experience.
real_world_impact: Sound engineers on accessibility teams create audio descriptions for visually impaired audiences, making film and theater experiences fully inclusive.

title: Music Therapist
description: Use music as a clinical tool to support mental health, rehabilitation, and emotional well-being.
sample_projects: volunteer at a senior center with music activities
shadow a licensed music therapist
research music's effect on a specific population
future_outlook: Growing recognition of mental health and non-pharmacological interventions is increasing demand. Board certification (MT-BC) is the standard credential.
why_exciting: Music therapy reaches people that traditional talk therapy cannot — patients with dementia, autism, or trauma. It is one of the most powerful clinical tools in behavioral health.
real_world_impact: Music therapists working with premature infants use rhythm and song to stabilize heart rates and improve brain development — helping fragile newborns grow stronger.

title: Journalist / Reporter
description: Research, investigate, and report on news and events for print, broadcast, or digital media.
sample_projects: write for a school or community newspaper
pitch and publish on a personal blog
produce a short audio documentary
future_outlook: Local newsrooms are shrinking, but digital journalism, investigative reporting, and niche publications are growing. Specialized journalists are in demand.
why_exciting: Journalism is democracy's safeguard. Investigative reporters expose corruption, give voice to the marginalized, and inform the decisions of millions.
real_world_impact: Investigative journalists at The Boston Globe exposed systemic sexual abuse by clergy — their reporting led to worldwide reforms and justice for thousands of survivors.

title: Content Creator / Influencer
description: Build an audience on social media, YouTube, or podcasting platforms by creating engaging, original content.
sample_projects: launch a YouTube channel with consistent upload schedule
grow a newsletter to 1,000 subscribers
partner with a local brand for a sponsored post
future_outlook: Creator economy exceeds $100B. Platform diversification creates multiple revenue streams. Business acumen separates sustainable creators from viral one-hit wonders.
why_exciting: You are your own media company. The best creators build communities, launch products, and have direct relationships with their audiences — bypassing gatekeepers entirely.
real_world_impact: Science creators on YouTube have introduced millions of young people to physics, biology, and engineering — inspiring STEM careers for students who felt excluded from traditional classrooms.

title: Screenwriter
description: Write scripts for films, TV shows, streaming series, and video games.
sample_projects: write a 10-page short film script
complete a 30-day script writing challenge
adapt a news story into a screenplay outline
future_outlook: Streaming has dramatically increased demand for original content. Video game narrative writing is growing fast.
why_exciting: Every great film started as words on a page. Screenwriters are the architects of stories that shape culture, empathy, and how people understand the world.
real_world_impact: Screenwriters behind shows like 'Pose' elevated marginalized voices to mainstream audiences, changing public conversation about transgender rights and identity.

title: Fashion Designer
description: Conceive, design, and develop clothing, footwear, and accessories for brands, collections, or independent lines.
sample_projects: design and sew a garment from scratch
create a 5-piece capsule collection concept
intern with a local boutique or designer
future_outlook: Sustainable fashion is reshaping the industry. Independent designers can launch globally through Shopify and Instagram. Technical design roles are stable.
why_exciting: Fashion is wearable art with cultural power. What people wear signals identity, politics, and belonging — and designers shape those signals.
opportunities: costume design for film and theater
real_world_impact: Fashion designers partnering with adaptive clothing organizations have created dignified, functional garments for people with disabilities — a $400B market historically ignored by mainstream fashion.

title: Costume Designer
description: Design and create clothing and accessories for film, TV, theater, opera, and live events.
sample_projects: design costumes for a school play
build a historically accurate period costume
create a character concept with clothing sketches
future_outlook: Strong demand from streaming (period dramas, fantasy series). Broadway and regional theater maintain steady employment.
why_exciting: You tell a character's whole story before they speak a word. The right costume transforms an actor and transports an audience.
real_world_impact: The costume team for 'Black Panther' created clothing rooted in Pan-African design traditions — sparking global conversations about African identity and cultural representation in media.

title: Personal Stylist / Wardrobe Stylist
description: Help individuals or brands develop their personal image, select wardrobes, and present themselves effectively.
sample_projects: style a friend for a special event
build an editorial lookbook portfolio
assist at a local fashion shoot
future_outlook: Growing market for image consulting as personal branding becomes more important. Celebrity stylists can earn $1M+; personal styling is accessible through independent practice.
why_exciting: When someone looks their best, they feel confident. Stylists help people show up powerfully for job interviews, major events, and everyday life.
real_world_impact: Stylists specializing in workforce-readiness programs help formerly incarcerated individuals dress for job interviews — with measurable impact on employment outcomes.

title: Athletic Trainer
description: Prevent, diagnose, and treat sports injuries for athletes at all levels — from high school teams to professional leagues.
sample_projects: shadow a certified athletic trainer
earn CPR/AED certification
research one common sports injury and its treatment protocols
future_outlook: Master's degree becoming standard. Expanding into industrial settings — AT for construction workers and manufacturing employees is a fast-growing non-sports market.
why_exciting: You are the first responder when athletes go down. Your decisions in the first minutes of an injury can determine whether someone plays again.
opportunities: high school and collegiate sports teams
real_world_impact: Athletic trainers pioneered concussion return-to-play protocols now required by 49 states, protecting millions of young athletes from dangerous premature returns after head injuries.

title: Sports Analyst
description: Collect, analyze, and interpret performance data to give coaches and teams a strategic competitive edge.
sample_projects: analyze a season's worth of stats and identify trends
build a player performance dashboard
replicate a famous sports analytics study
future_outlook: 'Moneyball' went mainstream — analytics departments exist in every major sport. Sports betting legalization has created another wave of analytical demand.
why_exciting: You give coaches and GMs superpowers. Your analysis might identify the undrafted player who becomes a star, or expose the opponent's pattern before the championship game.
real_world_impact: Sports analysts at multiple NBA teams built tracking systems that identified shooting form degradation early — allowing targeted interventions that extended players' careers by 2-3 years.

title: Physical Therapist
description: Help patients recover from injury, surgery, and illness through targeted movement and exercise therapy.
sample_projects: volunteer at a PT clinic
earn a CPR certification
observe a physical therapy evaluation and write a reflection
future_outlook: Consistently among the fastest-growing professions. Aging population and increased sports participation drive demand. Doctoral degree (DPT) required.
why_exciting: You give people their lives back — helping a stroke patient walk again, returning an athlete to the field, or reducing chronic pain for an elderly patient.
real_world_impact: Physical therapists developed early mobilization protocols for ICU patients — getting critically ill patients moving within days of intubation, dramatically reducing hospital stays.

title: Sports Coach
description: Develop athletes' skills, strategy, mental toughness, and character through instruction and mentorship.
sample_projects: volunteer coach a youth sports team
design a 4-week training program for a specific sport
shadow a varsity coach and write a strategic analysis
future_outlook: Coaching opportunities grow with youth sports participation. Collegiate coaching is competitive; high school coaching is accessible. Esports coaching is a new pathway.
why_exciting: Coaches shape not just athletic performance but character. The best coaches create not only champions — but better humans.
real_world_impact: Research shows athletes with high-quality coaches are significantly more likely to stay in school, avoid substance abuse, and develop leadership skills carried into adulthood.

title: Registered Nurse
description: Provide direct patient care — assessing health conditions, administering medications, and supporting recovery across all settings.
sample_projects: volunteer at a hospital or clinic
earn CNA certification as a high schooler
shadow a nurse in an ICU or ER for a day
future_outlook: Nursing shortage expected to deepen through 2035. One of the most secure career paths with a 2- or 4-year degree. Travel nursing pays $100K+ with housing.
why_exciting: Nurses are the heart of healthcare. You spend more time with patients than any other clinician — you truly know them and advocate for their needs.
real_world_impact: Nurses led the COVID-19 ICU response — creating and executing care protocols for a disease nobody had treated before, under impossible conditions.

title: Physician
description: Diagnose and treat illnesses, injuries, and medical conditions across primary care or specialty medicine.
sample_projects: shadow a physician in a specialty of interest
volunteer in a free clinic
research a condition and present to a class
future_outlook: Physician shortage in primary care and rural settings is severe and growing. Competitive path (4+4+3-7 years) with among the highest earning potential of any profession.
why_exciting: Medicine is the ultimate application of science — you use biology, chemistry, and human understanding to save lives and solve complex biological puzzles.
real_world_impact: Physicians conducting research discovered that H. pylori bacteria caused ulcers — overturning 50 years of medical doctrine and replacing surgery with a 10-day antibiotic course.

title: Pharmacist
description: Dispense medications, counsel patients on drug interactions, and serve as the most accessible healthcare professional.
sample_projects: shadow a pharmacist in a retail or hospital setting
research a commonly misused medication
learn about a drug class used in a common chronic disease
future_outlook: Clinical pharmacy roles in hospitals and specialty settings are growing. Retail pharmacist roles are stable. PharmD is a 4-year doctoral program.
why_exciting: Pharmacists are medication experts — catching dangerous interactions doctors miss and counseling people who are scared about new diagnoses.
real_world_impact: Hospital pharmacists on sepsis teams conduct medication reviews that identify life-threatening drug errors — studies show pharmacy-led programs reduce ICU mortality by up to 30%.

title: Occupational Therapist
description: Help people with injuries, disabilities, or conditions regain the ability to perform daily activities and live independently.
sample_projects: volunteer at a rehabilitation center
design an assistive device for a common daily task
research OT interventions for a specific population
future_outlook: Among the fastest-growing health professions. Pediatric, geriatric, and mental health settings all face OT shortages. Master's degree required.
why_exciting: OT is deeply creative — you solve unique human puzzles, finding new ways for each person to regain independence meaningful to them specifically.
real_world_impact: Occupational therapists helped veterans with traumatic hand amputations use advanced prosthetics to play guitar, cook, and parent their children — redefining what 'recovery' means.

title: Mental Health Counselor / Therapist
description: Support individuals and groups in managing mental health challenges through talk therapy, skills training, and clinical intervention.
sample_projects: volunteer on a crisis text hotline
shadow a therapist (with permission)
research evidence-based treatments for depression
future_outlook: Mental health workforce shortage is severe nationally. Telehealth dramatically expanded access and career flexibility.
why_exciting: Therapy changes lives — people emerge from treatment with better relationships, careers, and resilience. You witness transformations that are profound.
real_world_impact: Therapists providing trauma-focused CBT in schools serving refugee children have documented reductions in PTSD symptoms that allow students to focus and connect with peers for the first time.

title: K-12 Teacher
description: Educate and inspire students from kindergarten through 12th grade in core academic subjects or specialties.
sample_projects: tutor a struggling student
design a lesson plan for a subject you love
volunteer at an elementary school for a semester
future_outlook: Teacher shortage is severe in many US states, particularly in STEM, special education, and rural areas. Loan forgiveness programs available.
why_exciting: Teachers shape lives. Every successful professional can name a teacher who changed their trajectory. The impact compounds — you teach a child who teaches their children.
real_world_impact: A Harvard study found that replacing a below-average kindergarten teacher with an above-average one is worth $320,000 in lifetime earnings to each student in the class.

title: School Counselor
description: Guide students through academic, career, and personal challenges to support their success inside and beyond the classroom.
sample_projects: shadow a school counselor
design a college fair for a local school
lead a college prep workshop for peers
future_outlook: Demand growing as student mental health needs increase and college prep complexity grows. Master's degree and state licensure required.
why_exciting: School counselors see potential in students that students can't see in themselves yet. Catching a student before they fall through the cracks changes the trajectory of a life.
real_world_impact: School counselors who implemented universal screenings for anxiety identified 40% more at-risk students than referral-based systems — enabling early intervention that kept students in school.

title: Educational Technology Designer
description: Design digital learning experiences, e-learning courses, and educational software that improve how people learn.
sample_projects: build an interactive quiz module
design a game-based learning activity
create a video tutorial series for a skill
future_outlook: Corporate training and online education markets are massive and growing. Remote work boom dramatically increased demand for digital learning solutions.
why_exciting: Great instructional design makes complex skills learnable by anyone — from first-generation students mastering calculus to surgeons learning new procedures.
real_world_impact: Instructional designers built COVID-19 vaccine administration training deployed to 100,000+ pharmacists and nurses across the US in under 60 days.

title: Marketing Manager
description: Plan and execute campaigns that build brand awareness, generate leads, and drive customer acquisition.
sample_projects: run a social media campaign for a school club
analyze a brand's marketing and propose improvements
build a Google Ads campaign for a hypothetical product
future_outlook: Marketing is essential to every business. Digital marketing skills are in high demand. Specializations command premium salaries.
why_exciting: Marketing is where psychology meets creativity meets business. Understanding what makes people care — and act — is one of the most transferable skill sets in business.
real_world_impact: Marketers at GLAAD developed communication strategies that measurably shifted public opinion on marriage equality — demonstrating that strategic messaging can advance social justice.

title: Financial Analyst
description: Evaluate investment opportunities, build financial models, and guide organizations in capital allocation decisions.
sample_projects: build a 3-statement financial model for a public company
analyze a stock and write a 1-page investment thesis
complete a CFA prep module
future_outlook: Consistent demand across investment banking, corporate finance, private equity, and asset management. CFA designation significantly boosts compensation.
why_exciting: Financial analysts make the capital allocation decisions that determine which companies, technologies, and ideas get funded — shaping the future economy.
real_world_impact: Impact investing analysts direct capital toward renewable energy, affordable housing, and healthcare in underserved communities — proving financial return and social good can coexist.

title: Accountant / CPA
description: Record, analyze, and report financial data to ensure organizations comply with laws and make sound financial decisions.
sample_projects: prepare a personal tax return
reconcile a small business's accounts
volunteer at a free tax preparation clinic (VITA program)
future_outlook: CPA designation is one of the most recession-proof credentials. Remote accounting services are growing. Tax complexity ensures stable demand.
why_exciting: Accountants are the financial architects of every organization. Without accurate accounting, no company or government can make sound decisions or stay honest.
real_world_impact: Forensic accountants investigating the Enron scandal recovered billions for defrauded pensioners and employees — demonstrating that accounting expertise can be a force for justice.

title: Hotel & Hospitality Manager
description: Oversee the operations of hotels, resorts, or hospitality venues to deliver excellent guest experiences.
sample_projects: work a part-time front desk or service role
map out the operations of a hotel you visit
analyze the online reviews of a local hotel and propose improvements
future_outlook: Travel and hospitality industry rebounded strongly post-pandemic. Global hospitality degree opens international career doors.
why_exciting: Hospitality is the art of making people feel welcome. A truly great hotel stay becomes a memory people carry for life — and you orchestrate that.
real_world_impact: Hospitality managers running inclusive tourism programs have designed experiences accessible to visitors with disabilities — expanding who gets to experience America's natural wonders.

title: Chef / Culinary Professional
description: Create, develop, and execute cuisine for restaurants, catering, food brands, and media.
sample_projects: cook a multi-course dinner for family
recreate a restaurant dish from scratch
stage (intern) at a local restaurant kitchen
future_outlook: Restaurant industry is large but physically demanding. Food media creates celebrity chef paths. Corporate food developer and private chef roles offer more sustainable schedules.
why_exciting: Food is culture, memory, and love on a plate. Chefs with a distinctive voice can build a following, open restaurants, or create food brands that reach millions.
real_world_impact: Chefs partnering with food banks run programs that recover restaurant surplus food and cook nutritious meals for unhoused populations — transforming culinary expertise into social impact.

title: Event Planner
description: Coordinate all logistics for conferences, weddings, corporate events, and social gatherings.
sample_projects: plan a school fundraiser or prom
coordinate a small community event
shadow a wedding planner for a day
future_outlook: Events industry rebounded strongly after pandemic disruptions. Corporate event and conference planning is stable. Wedding industry continues to grow.
why_exciting: Events create moments people remember forever. You make the magic behind graduations, weddings, concerts, and launches — then watch people experience the day you built.
real_world_impact: Event planners organizing annual galas for children's hospitals raise millions in a single night — their logistical excellence directly funds medical equipment and research for sick kids.

title: Electrician
description: Install, maintain, and repair electrical systems in homes, commercial buildings, and industrial facilities.
sample_projects: wire a simple 3-way switch circuit
shadow a licensed electrician
complete a basic electrical safety course online
future_outlook: Severe shortage of licensed electricians nationally. Solar panel installation and EV charging infrastructure are creating massive new demand.
why_exciting: You make modern life possible. Every light, device, and system that runs on electricity needed an electrician to connect it safely — and complexity is growing with solar and EVs.
real_world_impact: Electricians installing solar microgrids in Puerto Rico after Hurricane Maria restored power to remote communities that federal infrastructure had left dark for months.

title: Plumber
description: Install and repair pipes, fixtures, and systems that carry water, gas, and waste in buildings and infrastructure.
sample_projects: fix a leaky faucet
replace a toilet
tour a commercial plumbing installation with a licensed plumber
future_outlook: Critical shortage of licensed plumbers. Average plumber wage exceeds many college-degreed professions. Master plumbers own businesses earning six figures.
why_exciting: Clean water and safe sanitation are fundamental to public health. Plumbers are essential to preventing waterborne disease, mold, and structural damage.
real_world_impact: Plumbers in Flint, Michigan worked alongside engineers and public health officials to remove lead service lines from homes with poisoned water.

title: HVAC Technician
description: Install, maintain, and repair heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and refrigeration systems.
sample_projects: change an HVAC filter and explain what you observe
shadow a technician on a maintenance call
earn an EPA 608 refrigerant certification
future_outlook: Residential and commercial HVAC demand is growing as climate change increases cooling needs. Heat pump and green building specializations command premium pay.
why_exciting: HVAC technicians keep hospitals, data centers, schools, and homes safe and comfortable — and increasingly, more energy efficient. Climate technology is transforming the field.
real_world_impact: HVAC technicians optimizing hospital ventilation during COVID-19 installed UV-C air filtration and adjusted air exchange rates — helping reduce airborne transmission in clinical settings.

title: Welder
description: Join metal parts using heat and fusing techniques across manufacturing, construction, aerospace, and underwater industries.
sample_projects: weld a simple steel frame project
shadow a welder in a manufacturing or construction setting
earn an AWS welding certification
future_outlook: Skilled welders are in acute shortage nationwide. Specialty welders (underwater, aerospace, nuclear) earn six figures. 2-year programs lead directly to high-paying jobs.
why_exciting: Welders built the Golden Gate Bridge, the International Space Station, and every skyscraper in every city skyline. You create permanent structures using skill and science.
real_world_impact: Underwater welders repair oil pipelines, submarine infrastructure, and harbor structures — working in environments no other professional can reach, preventing catastrophic failures.

title: Military Officer
description: Lead units, manage resources, and execute missions across Army, Navy, Air Force, Marines, Coast Guard, or Space Force.
related_majors: Any Major (via ROTC or Service Academy)
sample_projects: research a military occupational specialty (MOS)
join JROTC at your school
apply to a service academy summer seminar program
future_outlook: Military service provides free education, immediate leadership experience, and transition into lucrative civilian careers in management, defense contracting, and government.
why_exciting: Military officers lead hundreds of people through high-stakes situations. The leadership, ethics, and resilience you develop are unmatched by any other career path.
opportunities: combat arms and combat support roles
transition to defense industry or government
real_world_impact: Military officers led Operation Unified Assistance after the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami — coordinating 28 nations in the largest multinational disaster relief effort in history.

title: Law Enforcement Officer
description: Protect communities, investigate crimes, and enforce laws at local, state, or federal levels.
sample_projects: participate in a ride-along with local police
research community policing models
volunteer with a youth mentorship program
future_outlook: Police agencies in many cities are actively recruiting with sign-on bonuses and tuition assistance. Federal law enforcement (FBI, DEA, Border Patrol) is highly competitive.
why_exciting: Law enforcement is the intersection of service, justice, and problem-solving. First responders shape the safety of communities on their most difficult days.
opportunities: federal agencies (FBI, DEA, ATF, Secret Service)
real_world_impact: Law enforcement officers trained in crisis intervention have diverted thousands of individuals from arrest into mental health treatment — improving outcomes and reducing system burden.

title: Firefighter / EMT
description: Respond to emergencies including fires, accidents, and medical crises, protecting lives and property.
sample_projects: earn EMT-Basic certification (16+ in many states)
volunteer with a fire department
shadow a paramedic on a shift
future_outlook: Stable, respected career with strong benefits and retirement. Paramedic specialization adds earning potential. Combined fire/EMS roles are standard in most departments.
why_exciting: On the worst days of people's lives, you are the one who shows up. The physical, technical, and emotional demands are high — and so is the sense of purpose.
real_world_impact: Firefighter-paramedics implementing CPR-first protocols have achieved cardiac arrest save rates double the national average — research that changed treatment protocols nationwide.

title: Social Worker
description: Support vulnerable individuals and families — connecting them to resources, navigating systems, and advocating for their rights.
sample_projects: volunteer at a food bank, shelter, or community center
shadow a social worker
research your state's child welfare or foster care system
future_outlook: Severe social worker shortage in child welfare, healthcare, and schools. LCSW licensure enables clinical practice and therapy. Loan forgiveness programs available.
why_exciting: Social workers protect the most vulnerable people in society — intervening at crisis points and opening pathways to stability and dignity.
real_world_impact: Social workers embedded in emergency departments pioneered screening protocols for intimate partner violence, identifying and connecting thousands of abuse survivors to safety.

title: Policy Analyst
description: Research, evaluate, and propose public policies for government agencies, think tanks, or advocacy organizations.
sample_projects: write a policy brief on a local issue
analyze the impact of a recent policy change
attend a city council meeting and observe the process
future_outlook: Demand in think tanks, legislative offices, state and federal agencies, nonprofits, and international organizations. Graduate degree (MPP, MPA) often expected for senior roles.
why_exciting: Good policy analysis shapes laws that affect millions of lives. Your research might inform legislation on healthcare, climate, housing, or education.
real_world_impact: Policy analysts at the CDC developed the modeling frameworks used to guide social distancing decisions during COVID-19 — analysis that directly informed policies saving hundreds of thousands of lives.

title: Environmental Scientist
description: Study the environment and environmental problems, advising on policies and solutions to protect ecosystems and human health.
sample_projects: conduct a water quality test on a local stream
map a local watershed using GIS tools
volunteer with a land conservation organization
future_outlook: Growing demand driven by climate change, environmental regulations, and corporate ESG commitments. Federal agencies (EPA), state agencies, and consulting firms all hire.
why_exciting: Environmental scientists work to protect the air, water, and land we all depend on. Addressing climate change and protecting biodiversity — the stakes don't get higher.
real_world_impact: Environmental scientists characterizing PFAS ('forever chemicals') contamination in drinking water exposed risks affecting millions of Americans — driving EPA regulations and multi-billion-dollar cleanup commitments.

title: Wildlife Biologist
description: Study the behavior, population dynamics, and habitat needs of wild animals, advising on conservation and management.
sample_projects: participate in a bird count survey (eBird, Christmas Bird Count)
design a habitat survey for a local area
analyze a wildlife population dataset
future_outlook: Competitive field — graduate degrees preferred for research positions. Government agencies (USFWS, state wildlife agencies) hire steady numbers.
why_exciting: Wildlife biologists work in some of the world's most spectacular environments, uncovering how animals live and what they need to survive in a rapidly changing world.
real_world_impact: Wildlife biologists studying grizzly bear corridor connectivity in the Northern Rockies provided data used to reconnect isolated populations — reversing local extinction risk and restoring genetic diversity.

title: Agronomist / Precision Agriculture Specialist
description: Apply science and technology to improve crop production, soil health, and sustainable farming practices.
sample_projects: design a simple soil health experiment
research a crop disease and its management
explore a precision agriculture mapping tool (Climate FieldView)
future_outlook: Precision agriculture is transforming the field — drone pilots, data analysts, and soil scientists are all in demand. Food security concerns drive research funding.
why_exciting: Agronomists solve the fundamental human challenge: growing enough food to feed everyone — using data, satellites, and AI to make every acre more productive with less environmental impact.
real_world_impact: Agronomists developing drought-resistant crop varieties have helped subsistence farmers in Sub-Saharan Africa maintain harvests through climate disruptions — preventing crop failures that would cause famine.

title: Geospatial Engineer
description: Collect, analyze, and visualize location-based data to solve problems in urban planning, defense, disaster response, and environmental management.
sample_projects: map a neighborhood using OpenStreetMap
analyze satellite imagery for land use change
build a web map showing local points of interest
future_outlook: Location data is now central to logistics, autonomous vehicles, climate modeling, and urban planning. Geospatial skills are valued in tech, government, defense, and consulting.
why_exciting: Every physical problem is also a location problem. Geospatial engineers provide the maps and analysis that guide emergency response, city planning, and environmental protection.
real_world_impact: Geospatial engineers created the real-time flood risk mapping systems used by FEMA during Hurricane Harvey to prioritize rescue operations in Houston — saving hundreds of lives.

title: Robotics Engineer
description: Design, build, and program robots and automated systems for manufacturing, healthcare, exploration, and consumer applications.
sample_projects: build a robot in FIRST Robotics or VEX
program a servo-driven arm using Arduino
simulate a robot arm in ROS
future_outlook: Robotics is one of the fastest-growing engineering specialties. Warehouse automation, surgical robots, and manufacturing robots are driving hiring surges.
why_exciting: You design machines that do what humans cannot — work in nuclear reactors, explore Mars, or perform surgery through a 1-cm incision.
real_world_impact: Robotics engineers at Boston Dynamics built robots that inspect aging infrastructure (bridges, pipelines, power plants) in dangerous environments — preventing catastrophic failures without risking human lives.
